name: alternate heel touch side kick squat
source_instructions: Stand and kick one leg to the side.
Touch the heel with your hand.
interpretation: Two hip-width squats alternate a left and right side kick. Each kick extends laterally, then rechambers slightly while the trunk bends toward that side to permit a same-side relaxed little-fingertip edge tap on the medial/posterior heel. The source does not specify kick height, trunk angle, contact finger or numeric timing; these are authored choices. Actual fingertip and whole-hand skin contact distances are measured separately. There is no wrapped grasp or added forearm supination. Takeoff and landing are declared airborne; the opposite sole stays planted.

correctives.runtime: Four compact additive standard glTF POSITION/NORMAL targets before linear skinning. Active rear-knee lunge target or active-side heel-touch shoulder target; all unrelated keys explicitly zero.
correctives.construction: One local CorrectiveSmooth20x1.0 target per mirrored diagnosed collar, C1 source domain, exact inverse LBS and C1 radial25mm cap. No runtime DQ or smoothing.
